no: Let Oa be the circle centered at A and tangent to the Euler line; define Ob and Oc cyclically. Let La be the polar of X_4 wrt Oa, and define Lb and Lc cyclically. (Note: X_4 is the perspector of any circle centered at a vertex of ABC.) Let A' = Lb∩Lc, and define B' and C' cyclically. Triangle A'B'C' is the reflection of ABC in X_5972, which is the radical center of Oa, Ob, Oc. A'B'C' is homothetic to the medial triangle at X_125 and to the anticomplementary triangle at X_110. X_13202 = X_20-of-A'B'C'. (Randy Hutson, July 21, 2017)
